name: Fog Volume Injection Optimization
aliases: Fog Volume Injection Optimization — Froxel-culled fog injection
Inject SGL3D fog volumes only into the froxels they reach
inject scene fog volumes only into the froxels they cover
definition: An optimization where scene fog volumes are injected only into the froxels they geometrically cover, rather than having every froxel test every scene fog volume.
summary: Fog Volume Injection Optimization reduces computational cost by culling irrelevant volume-froxel pairs using precomputed bounds, avoiding the overhead of many small kernel launches.
